title: Ancillary and Optional Services Billing: Payer Matrix by Ancillary Account Tier
content:
Under Ancillary and Optional Services Billing, each ancillary account tier fixes who pays covered ancillary items for a resident in that tier, whether Medicare SNF consolidated billing bundles covered supplies, drugs, lab and radiology into the Part A per diem, whether drugs, supplies and equipment related to the terminal illness are the hospice's to provide and pay, and whether the Medicare Advantage plan's authorization is needed before a covered item is supplied.

## Tier matrix

| Ancillary account tier | Who pays covered ancillary items | Consolidated billing bundles covered supplies, drugs, lab and radiology into the Part A per diem | Terminal-illness drugs, supplies and equipment are the hospice's to provide and pay | Plan authorization needed before a covered item is supplied |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing | Medicare Part A | Yes | No | No |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B | Medicare Part B | No | No | No |
| Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance | Medicaid | No | No | No |
| Ancillary Account, Private Pay | Private pay | No | No | No |
| Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage | Medicare Advantage | No | No | Yes |
| Ancillary Account, Hospice Election | Hospice | No | Yes | No |

## Entries identical in every tier

- **Services outside consolidated billing**, which the furnishing provider bills separately: physician professional services; dialysis and related ambulance; certain chemotherapy; customized prosthetics; emergency room services.
- **How a Medicare Advantage resident's share is set**: the patient responsibility on the plan's remittance.

## Reading the matrix

Because the matrix covers all six tiers, the following readings follow directly from it:

- The bundling column reads Yes in one tier only, Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing.
- The hospice column reads Yes in one tier only, Ancillary Account, Hospice Election.
- The authorization column reads Yes in one tier only, Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage.
- The list of services outside consolidated billing and the basis of a Medicare Advantage resident's share are the same five services and the same basis whichever tier the account is in.
